title: 第41章 间谍小头目居然是个…

第41章 间谍小头目居然是个…-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

有了精准的船舶航行线索，先前划定的三片区域便能逐一推演排除。

董家渡沿岸偏离主航道，距离货轮通行航线较远，汽笛经过长距离传播会严重衰减、音质浑浊；

南外滩滨江段地处南浦大桥上游，受楼宇建筑群与江面风向遮挡，声响会沉闷模糊。

可视频中的汽笛清亮通透，没有任何杂音，足以证明，当时录音者就在大桥下游、紧靠航道的近岸位置。

所有线索层层收拢，最终精准锁定——十六铺老码头沿岸。

整片岸线范围瞬间压缩，总长不足两公里，再剔除后期翻新改造的商业滨江步道与景观绿地，真正留存老城风貌、清晨有早市摊贩沿街叫卖的，仅剩短短四百米左右的老旧街巷。

这片区域楼栋低矮密集，多是老式居民楼、老旧民宿和小型私家旅馆，环境杂乱隐蔽，完美契合录音里的背景音效与场景条件。

他暗自思忖，天珠的探测距离仅有十米，容不得大范围盲目搜寻，必须把范围压缩到极致，逐栋、逐段细致排查。

对方身上藏有自杀胶囊，足以佐证背后势力的凶狠与谨慎。留给自己的排查时间极其有限，稍有耽搁，便会彻底错失线索，再无追踪的可能。

顾承安收起手机，即刻动身赶往十六铺老码头片区。

他的搜寻方式有点异于常人，所以他没有叫上其他人，况且他对自己的身手有十足的信心。

十几分钟后，顾承安出现在码头东路。

老城区路边的早餐摊还冒着蒸汽，油条在锅里翻滚。

几栋六层居民楼穿插在小旅馆之间，外墙刷着米黄涂料，窗外拉着晾衣绳，挂着衣物和床单。底楼临街面开着杂货铺、棋牌室、修鞋摊。

顾承安没有急着往前赶，而是控制着步速，沿码头东路南侧，贴着建筑一楼外墙往前走。

第一栋六层居民楼，三个单元门。

他从西头的一单元起步，沿着外墙匀速经过，脚步不快不慢，像一个出来遛弯的本地居民。

不到一分钟走完整栋楼，没动静。

再折返上单元的3楼，没动静，下一个单元，继续如此。

第二栋五层居民楼，两个单元，依旧安静。

继续往前，一栋、两栋、三栋。

连续走过七八栋建筑，一路毫无收获。

二十多分钟后，走完四百米路段，抵达码头中路路口。

天珠自始至终没有发出提醒。

顾承安在路口停下脚步，没有继续前行。

他转过身，回望整条行进路线。

两侧建筑高低错落，南侧他刚走过的楼栋已经全部排查完毕，确认干净。

那就是漏了。

With accurate ship navigation clues, the three previously defined areas can be deduced and eliminated one by one.

The Dongjiadu coast deviates from the main channel and is far from the cargo ship route. The whistle will be severely attenuated and the sound quality will be muddy after being propagated over a long distance;

The riverside section of the South Bund is located upstream of the Nanpu Bridge. It is blocked by the buildings and the wind direction of the river, so the sound will be dull and blurred.

However, the whistle in the video is clear and transparent without any noise, which is enough to prove that the recorder was downstream of the bridge and close to the shore of the channel.

All the clues were gathered layer by layer, and finally they were accurately locked - along the shore of Shiliupu Old Wharf.

The entire coastline was instantly compressed, with a total length of less than two kilometers. After excluding the later-renovated commercial riverside trails and landscaped green spaces, only about 400 meters of old streets and alleys were left that truly retained the style of the old city and had morning market vendors hawking along the streets.

The buildings in this area are low and dense, mostly old-fashioned residential buildings, old B&Bs and small private hotels. The environment is messy and hidden, which perfectly suits the background sound effects and scene conditions in the recording.

He thought to himself that the detection distance of the Dzi Bead was only ten meters, which did not allow for a large-scale blind search. He had to compress the range to the extreme and conduct detailed inspections one by one, building by building and section by section.

The suicide capsule hidden on the other party's body is enough to prove the ferocity and caution of the forces behind it.The time left for you to investigate is extremely limited. If you delay even a little bit, you will completely miss the clues and there will be no possibility of tracking them.

Gu Chengan put away his cell phone and immediately set off for the Shiliupu Old Wharf area.

His search method was a bit different from ordinary people, so he didn't call anyone else, and he had full confidence in his own skills.

Ten minutes later, Gu Chengan appeared on Pier East Road.

The breakfast stalls on the roadside in the old town are still steaming, and the fried dough sticks are tumbling in the pot.

Several six-story residential buildings are interspersed between small hotels. The exterior walls are painted with beige paint, and clothes and sheets are hung on clotheslines outside the windows.On the ground floor facing the street are a grocery store, a chess and card room, and a shoe repair stall.

Gu Chengan did not rush forward, but controlled his pace and walked along the south side of Pier East Road, close to the outer wall of the first floor of the building.

The first six-story residential building has three unit doors.

He started from a unit at the west end and passed along the outer wall at a steady pace, neither fast nor slow, like a local resident out for a walk.

I walked through the entire building in less than a minute, but there was no movement.

Then I turned back to the third floor of the upper unit, but there was no movement. The next unit continued like this.

The second five-story residential building, with two units, is still quiet.

Keep going, one building, two buildings, three buildings.

I walked past seven or eight buildings in a row, but gained nothing along the way.

After more than 20 minutes, after walking 400 meters, we arrived at the intersection of Pier Middle Road.

Dzi Bead never issued a reminder from beginning to end.

Gu Chengan stopped at the intersection and did not continue moving forward.

He turned around and looked back at the entire route.

The buildings on both sides were staggered, and the buildings he had just passed on the south side had all been inspected and confirmed to be clean.

That's a leak.
